headline: The next big indie game publisher is taking some exciting swings
summary: Kinetic Publishing, from the Phasmophobia team, unveiled five ambitious new indie titles. These games are set for release in 2027 and 2028. The showcase included the next game from the creator of Telling Lies.

headline: It looks like Apple’s iPhone 18 really will skip the fall launch this year
summary: Apple's base iPhone 18 is reportedly delayed, launching in Q1 next year. The iPhone 18 Pro series will still arrive this fall. New iPhone 18e and iPhone Air models are also anticipated.

headline: Google’s Pixel 11 phone preorders come with up to $350 in gift cards
summary: Google officially announced its new Pixel 11 phones and watches. The base Pixel 11 starts at $899, with Pro and Fold models available. Preorders include up to $350 in gift cards.

headline: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
summary: Twitch users can now opt out of allowing their content for Amazon's generative AI training. This includes streams, VODs, clips, chats, and channel text/pictures. Opting out prevents content from being used in future Amazon AI models.

headline: LEGO Reveals Nike Air Force 1 Set With a New Version of the Classic Spaceman Minifigure
summary: LEGO unveiled an upcoming set based on Nike's iconic Air Force 1 sneaker. The set includes a new version of the Classic Spaceman minifigure. This collaboration blends sneaker culture with LEGO creativity.

headline: Coyote vs. Acme Debuts With Perfect 100% Score on Rotten Tomatoes
summary: Coyote vs. Acme achieved a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. The film is finally set for theatrical release after two years of being shelved. Critics are praising the long-awaited movie.

headline: DC's TV Division Reportedly Scrapped Two Key TV Projects, Rejected Pitches for Catwoman and Poison Ivy Shows
summary: DC Studios has reportedly canceled two previously announced TV shows. Pitches for Catwoman and Poison Ivy shows were also rejected. This indicates a significant shift in DC's TV strategy.

headline: Xbox Reveals Stunning 3D-Moulded Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition Controllers
summary: Microsoft unveiled new Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition Xbox controllers. The controllers feature highly-detailed 3D-moulded designs. They capture the gruff, grizzled aesthetic of the game.

headline: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
summary: Ukrainian forces attacked major Russian grain export terminals in the Black Sea. Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are now falling. This marks an escalation targeting shipping facilities.

headline: Double killer and rapist given whole life sentence
summary: Simon Levy received a whole life sentence for his crimes. He was convicted for the murder of two women. Levy also committed the rape of a third victim.

headline: Burnham urges shops not to sell disposable BBQs over wildfire risks
summary: The PM urges shops to stop selling disposable BBQs. This is due to high wildfire risks during the current spell of extremely dry weather. The public is asked to avoid using single-use grills.

headline: Students wait for A-level, T-level and BTec results
summary: Students are currently awaiting their A-level, T-level, and BTec results. A record number are expected to secure a place at their first-choice university. Anticipation is high across the country for these results.
